how_we_make_money_main_html:
Home/How we make money

How we make money

System Compare is published by CLICSYNC LTD. Some supplier links are affiliate links, labelled “Ad · affiliate link”. We may receive a commission when a purchase is attributed to one of these referrals.

Offers and evidence

An affiliate button takes you to the supplier’s offer. Links in source libraries and evidence records lead directly to the cited pages. An offer does not establish that its plan includes every capability described in our research. Confirm the current price and terms with the supplier.

Privacy after you click

Our /go/ addresses redirect to a configured destination without forwarding visitor query parameters. They do not set our own affiliate cookie. The supplier or its partner network may use its own referral measurement and cookies after you arrive. Google Analytics click measurement on our site requires analytics consent.

Privacy policy · Comparison methodology · Contact
contact_main_html:
Home/Contact System Compare

SYSTEM COMPARE

Contact System Compare

Questions, corrections, partnerships or privacy requests: send a message to the System Compare team.

How can we help?

All fields are required. Choose the topic that best matches your request.

Please do not include passwords, payment-card details or other unnecessary sensitive information.

You can also email us directly:

support@system-compare.com

CLICSYNC LTD processes the details you provide to handle your enquiry. Messages are sent through our contact service hosted on systemcompare.co.il to our central support team. A limited anti-spam check uses your IP address. No analytics or third-party CAPTCHA is loaded on the contact form page.

privacy policy

Research corrections

Include the product, the exact claim, the plan and a supporting official source. Read the corrections process. Commercial proposals do not change our scoring rules.

Supplier applications

To propose a new product, use the Partners program. The initial application is free and nonbinding. Messages sent through this general form, including the Partnership topic, go to our central support team; they do not create a Partners application.

partners_apply_body_html:
Skip to content
System Compare

System Compare partner network

SYSTEM COMPARE PARTNERS

Tell us about your software.

Approval invitation emails are available in Hebrew and English. Other correspondence languages receive an English invitation; your selected correspondence language is saved for the team.

This central application workspace serves all System Compare editions. The publisher is CLICSYNC LTD, Israel.

Applying is free. Our team manually reviews eligibility. If eligible, you can continue through a personal link and review the proposed scope, final fee and commercial terms before deciding whether to agree. There is no charge, listing approval or marketing subscription when you apply.

Checking availability…

Online applications are temporarily unavailable. Send your company, product, official website and requested markets to partnerships@system-compare.com.

Existing supplier listing

Factual corrections and an included six-month review do not require a paid rescan. Contact our team if either applies.

Requested country editions — select 1 to 25
Relevant software categories — select at least one

This helps route your request; the editorial team decides final placement.

No categories match your search.

New category proposal

Provide at least five distinct companies and their official websites, including your own if relevant. These are research candidates, not verified product claims.

No payment is requested. After a successful submission, keep the reference number shown on screen. This page confirms receipt. After approval and a completed service proposal, a separate email can provide your personal continuation link.

Application received

Keep your reference number:

Your request is in our staff review queue. If eligible, our team will arrange a personal continuation link so you can review any proposed service before agreement. No payment has been taken. The on-screen status distinguishes the saved application from staff email acceptance. Invitation email status is managed separately from receipt of this form. Contact partnerships@system-compare.com with this reference if you need to follow up.

Application privacy information

CLICSYNC LTD, Israel company 515343549, 9 Tversky Street, Tel Aviv-Yafo 6721010, Israel, is responsible for this application service. For privacy and data-rights requests, contact support@system-compare.com.

We collect your company and product names, official website, business contact name and email, requested markets and categories, correspondence language, request type, proposed category and candidate company names/URLs or existing listing URL, authority/privacy acknowledgments and a submission reference. We use them to identify the supplier, verify authority, assess eligibility, respond and administer a possible service. These fields are not verified evidence of product features and are not published as public contact data. Required fields let us identify and handle the application; you may instead contact us by email.

We also save the originating System Compare edition and page language supplied in the application link to help route your request. These link values are not independently verified.

We use legitimate interests in handling business enquiries and protecting the service, and, where applicable, steps requested by a contracting party before a contract. Technical request information is used for security and bounded abuse prevention. No optional analytics is loaded on this application or the private portal.

Authorized staff access a separate private application database on the existing OpenAI Sites/Cloudflare infrastructure. The operator is in Israel; hosting and email providers may process information in other countries under applicable arrangements. Applications and review records are retained for the request, necessary business records and applicable legal obligations. You can request the relevant retention or transfer information and exercise applicable access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection or portability rights by contacting us. You may complain to the relevant data protection authority.

Applying does not subscribe you to marketing. Any PayPal processing is explained in the private workspace before agreement and payment. A separate staff email notification is queued when you apply. Following approval, a personal continuation invitation may be sent to your application email. No automated research scanner is promised. See the site privacy notice, onboarding terms and terms of use.
